data.credibility: Management frequently guides ambitious targets like $1 billion revenue or specific working capital days, only to drop topics or see them slip when actual results lag. While some operational milestones are met, financial targets often require quiet adjustments or get abandoned.

lines.line: Targeted $1 billion revenue by fiscal 2028, but the topic was dropped without delivery.
Targeted net working capital of 85 days by March 2026, but the goal was dropped.
Expected minimum INR 1,500 crores from OSAT, lowered in Q4 FY26 and later dropped.
Expected minimum INR 1,000 crores from PC Board, lowered in Q4 FY26 and later dropped.
OSAT Unit 2 commercialization targeted for Q2 FY26 slipped as expected deadlines were missed.
NPD contribution targeted at nearly 30%, but actual stood at 19.8% in FY27, slipping.
Rail business growth targeted at 20 to 25%, but actual reached 19.8% and was dropped.
Targeted INR 450 to 500 crores commercial revenue for OSAT and PCB, currently pending.
Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Circuit Chennai operational by Q3 FY27, successfully kept.
Planned INR 300 crores capex each for OSAT and PCB for the year, currently pending.
Planned INR 250 crores capex for EMS business for the year, currently pending.
Confident of >30% electronic business growth for FY27, but current actual is 19.8%, slipping.

bull: Revenue has compounded strongly at 53.9% annually over five years, reaching a TTM figure of ₹3,945 crores.
The order book stood robust at ₹83,663 Mn as of March 31, 2026, supporting future visibility.
EBITDA margin improved steadily from 10.0% in FY21 to 14.5% TTM and 15.9% in FY26.
bear: Operating cash flow was -63% of reported profit over five years, with negative cash flows in FY23, FY25, and FY26.
Working-capital days have stretched significantly from 50 to 133 days over the past five years.
Borrowings increased substantially from ₹148 cr in FY21 to ₹1,986 cr against a net worth of ₹4,935 cr.
